info.prompt: (Neon Cyan Dice Glow | Electric Magenta Neural Lattice | Void Black Cathedral Backdrop | Skeletal Gold UI Filigree | Amber Alchemical Sigils)—A close-up of translucent dice mid-roll, their faceted surfaces refracting bioluminescent hacker-glyphs onto a bone-like table etched with synaptic pathways, while the camera sweeps dynamically through a haze of particulate gold dust, revealing distant cyber-Gothic spires pulsing to the rhythm of an unseen heart monitor’s oscilloscope readout.
